title: Analysis-Software selloff is disrupting some M&A and IPO deals, US bankers say
title_zh: 分析——美国银行家表示，软件抛售正在扰乱一些并购和首次公开募股交易
summary: A broad selloff in software stocks is starting to stall deal-making and IPOs in the sector as volatility makes valuations unreliable and potential buyers cautious, about a dozen financial advisers and dealmakers told Reuters.
summary_zh: 大约十几名财务顾问和交易撮合者告诉路透社，软件股的广泛抛售开始阻碍该行业的交易和首次公开募股，因为波动性导致估值不可靠，潜在买家变得谨慎。

title: EC approves $32bn Google-Wiz deal after market investigation
title_zh: 市场调查后，欧盟委员会批准 Google-Wiz 价值 320 亿美元的交易
summary: Google’s acquisition of Wiz is set to bolster its cloud security capabilities and support multi-cloud operations amid AI growth.
summary_zh: 谷歌收购 Wiz 将增强其云安全能力，并在人工智能增长的背景下支持多云运营。

title: Goldman’s Solomon Bullish on Dealmaking, but Expects ‘Speed Bump’
title_zh: 高盛的所罗门看好交易，但预计会出现“减速”
summary: Goldman Sachs's chief executive reiterated a bullish forecast for mergers and acquisitions in 2026, but cautioned about a possible speed bump ahead.
summary_zh: 高盛首席执行官重申了对 2026 年并购的乐观预测，但警告称未来可能会出现放缓。

title: Carlyle’s flagship buyout funds gain after flurry of portfolio IPOs
